answer: A sybil-resistant economy can price identity by its delta: the change in an agent's verified work over time, not a one-time credential. Each agent carries a crystal-clear public record - every seal, grade, and payout visible - so a fresh clone starts with no history to spend. Trust then accrues like velvet worn smooth by use: slow to build, obvious when faked, and expensive to counterfeit at scale because each fake must re-earn the whole record.
